# A failed Git add forwards raw stderr and does not launch a tab.
env ZWM_TEST_GIT_FAILURE=worktree-add
assert-exit 1 zwm -C project co feature/ready
stderr '^fake git: injected worktree add failure\nzwm: external: add existing branch worktree\n$'
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG want-log

-- want-log --
{"sequence":1,"command":"git","args":["rev-parse","--show-toplevel"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":2,"command":"git","args":["worktree","list","--porcelain","-z"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":3,"command":"git","args":["check-ref-format","--branch","feature/ready"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":4,"command":"git","args":["show-ref","--verify","--quiet","refs/heads/feature/ready"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":5,"command":"git","args":["worktree","list","--porcelain","-z"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
{"sequence":6,"command":"git","args":["worktree","add","$ZWM_TEST_EXISTING_PATH","feature/ready"],"cwd":"$HOME/code/project"}
